Specimen: Years ago I was one day walking in the hills with friends. We found a horse jawn. We realiced there were a lot of more bones spread all arround. We found it funny to gather them  toguether and soon we had an almost whole horse skeleton. As I love to keep any sort of useless things, the day after we went back up to the hills and carried it home in bags. Its been in my garage for years.
I allwais knew it would one day come in handy for something. It was much later when i setarted to do 3d art and specialize on character and animals. So finally it has served a sort of scientific artistic research about horse anatomy. Along with it, I have used many grafic references but it has been great to have the real thing.
If you are interested in horse anatomy eigther for artistic or scientific reasosn I hope you find this model usefull. Everything is simetrical except the legs. So if you need it simetrical for rigging purposes or whatever, you can delete those of one side and mirror the other,
